Privacy notice - The launcher stores necessary configuration information locally (such as version settings, agreement acceptance status and time, AI service configuration items, etc.) to provide basic functionality. - Multiplayer, download and login features communicate with corresponding services; apart from information necessary to implement functionality, the launcher does not proactively upload personal privacy data unrelated to your game content. - If you enable the AI assistant and configure a third-party service, relevant conversation content will be sent to the selected service according to your configuration; please do not enter passwords, official account tokens, payment information, or other sensitive data in conversations.
6. AI feature description and disclaimer - The built-in AI assistant is only for offline assistance: command explanation and correction, startup failure log analysis, preliminary crash diagnosis, Java/renderer setting suggestions, mod/data pack/resource pack instructions, common Terracotta multiplayer questions, gameplay and walkthrough queries, etc. - AI replies may be inaccurate or outdated, and do not constitute official customer service, legal, account security or payment advice. Please verify key conclusions yourself and be cautious with account and security operations.
7. Terracotta multiplayer notice - Terracotta multiplayer is based on P2P technology. After a successful connection, participating devices connect directly whenever possible; under normal circumstances game traffic is not relayed through third-party servers (except necessary signaling such as node discovery/coordination, as implemented). - When using the multiplayer feature, you should comply with local laws, regulations and network usage rules, and must not use multiplayer for illegal activities.
